crop.notes: Headline, subhead and full text in two pieces.

ocr.notes: Subhead 'Tom Allen's Guests Expect to Get a Fight on While Here' is missing; 'Charley Daly' shortened to 'Daly'; 'taken up quarters' and 'awake him' slightly changed. Otherwise matches.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that heavyweight "Denver Ed" Smith and Ike Weir, the "Belfast Spider," were staying at Tom Allen's place, where Allen would back Smith if he could get a match with one of the big fellows.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Monday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, June 14, 1897, page 5.

facts.fact: "Denver Ed" Smith (from Cincinnati), his brother Pat (from Chicago) and Ike Weir of Boston, the "Belfast Spider," took quarters at Tom Allen's place in St. Louis while seeking matches
Allen agreed to back "Denver Ed" Smith if Smith could get a fight with any of the big heavyweights; Smith would train in St. Louis after a month at Hot Springs

notes: Calls Allen 'the ex-heavy weight world's champion'. Arrival time (3 a.m. Monday) conflicts with article 174's 'last night'.
